Messages.Author: The Name Forgotten
Messages.Body:
Can a vampire gain from perfectionist after calling Eldest Command
Undeath?

If they don't, then what happens if they Freak Drive afterwards and
perform another action that fulfills the conditions of perfectionist?

Thanking you in advance.
Val.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
The Name Forgotten wrote:
> Can a vampire gain from perfectionist after calling Eldest Command
> Undeath?

No. The blood goes to the bank instead.

> If they don't, then what happens if they Freak Drive afterwards and
> perform another action that fulfills the conditions of perfectionist?

Nothing. Perfectionist only works once per turn.
